faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Questions, concerns, and inquiries managed by our users
faq.a1: Inventra is an AI-powered tool that helps you create optimized e-commerce listings in seconds, saving you hours of work.
faq.a2: Inventra is designed for e-commerce sellers who need to create quick, clear, and optimized listings for platforms like Mercado Libre, Facebook Marketplace, and more.
faq.a3: Just enter your product's basic information and our AI automatically generates an optimized listing for the platform where you want to sell.
faq.q4: Can I use it even without an e-commerce store?
faq.a4: Yes. You don't need your own e-commerce store. Inventra works for anyone who needs to create listings to sell products on online platforms.
faq.q5: What sets us apart from the competition?
faq.a5: Inventra is specifically designed to create e-commerce listings. It uses optimized formats, proven sales structures, and up-to-date platform data to generate ready-to-publish listings.
faq.q6: What types of plans does Inventra offer?

guide.title: Inventra Usage Manual
guide.subtitle: Complete guide to create listings that sell. Follow these steps to get the best results.

section0.title: High-Quality Image Capture
section0.description: Image is the most important thing. A good photo attracts more buyers.

step0.title: Perfect Lighting
step0.description: Use natural or clear lighting so the product looks good.

tips.0: Take photos during the day by a window
tips.2: If it's night, use white/LED lights
tips.3: Avoid yellowish light that distorts colors

step1.title: Clean Background
step1.description: A simple background makes the product stand out.

tips.0: Use white, gray, or neutral background
tips.1: You can use our background remover in 'Image Optimization'
tips.2: Avoid cluttered backgrounds or competing colors
tips.3: The product should be the star

step2.title: Strategic Angles
step2.description: Show the product from its best angles.

tips.0: Photograph from the front for the first image
tips.3: For electronics: show screen, buttons, connectors

step3.title: High Resolution
step3.description: Clear and sharp images generate more trust.

tips.1: Use our upscaler if your photos are small

examples.good: Clear photo with natural lighting, white background, sharp and well-focused product
examples.bad: Blurry photo, cluttered background, poor lighting, small product in image

section1.title: Accurate Product Data
section1.description: Correct information increases buyer visibility and trust.

step0.title: Brand and Model
step0.description: Be specific with the exact brand and model.

tips.1: Include the exact model (e.g., iPhone 15 Pro Max)

step1.title: Product Condition
step1.description: Indicate if it's new, used, refurbished, etc.

tips.3: Be honest: increases sales and reduces returns

step2.title: Correct Category
step2.description: Classify your product in the appropriate category.

tips.0: Choose the most specific category possible
tips.1: Don't force product into wrong category
tips.2: Example: Audi A4 in 'Cars > Sedans' not 'Accessories'
High stock = more trust if legitimate

section2.title: Winning Description
section2.description: A clear and convincing description sells faster.

tips.3: Use bullet points for main features

step1.title: Keywords (SEO)
step1.description: Use terms that buyers search for.

tips.1: Think: how would a buyer search for this?
tips.2: Example: Not 'car' but 'Audi A4 2018 sedan gasoline'
tips.3: Repeat keywords 2-3 times without sounding like spam

step2.title: Highlight Benefits
step2.description: Explain the value, not just features.

tips.0: Not just '4K Screen' but '4K Screen for HD movies without ads'
tips.1: Benefit = how it improves the buyer's life

tips.3: Honesty = fewer returns and better reputation

examples.good: iPhone 15 Pro Max 256GB. New unopened. Apple 1-year warranty. Professional camera, A17 processor. Perfect for photography.
examples.bad: iphone very good cheap price only owner

section3.title: Realistic and Competitive Price
section3.description: The right price generates fast sales.

tips.0: Search for the same product on the platform

step1.title: Use AI to Estimate
step1.description: Our AI analyzes images to suggest price.

tips.0: Upload a clear photo of your product
tips.1: AI will consider: brand, model, condition

tips.2: Free shipping = raise 3-5% over base price
tips.3: New in box = raise 20-30% vs used

tips.0: High initial price, then discount = generates FOMO
Fill in brand, model, condition, category

step1.title: Upload Clear Image
step1.description: AI analyzes the image to estimate price.

tips.2: No people or hands (just the product)

step2.title: Press Optimize
step2.description: Let the AI do the magic.

tips.0: AI will generate: title, description, price, hashtags
tips.2: You can edit results if needed
tips.3: Use the suggestion as a base to improve

step3.title: Review and Publish
step3.description: Verify before publishing to your platform.

tips.0: Read the title: is it attractive? Has key info?
tips.1: Review description: would you buy this?
tips.3: Copy and publish to your platform

section5.title: Recommended Platforms
section5.description: Where to publish for maximum reach.

tips.2: They seek quality, not low price

tips.0: Better if you have multiple units

proTips.title: Pro Tips to Beat the Competition

tips.2: Update price every 3 days if unsold
